canonical_project: Mali National Tier III Data Center (SMTD-SA / AGETIC)
owner: Societe Malienne de Transmission et de Diffusion (SMTD-SA), with AGETIC and Huawei involvement
notes: National Tier III data center in Bamako inaugurated on 2026-01-31. Reported as intended to support public cloud, data sovereignty and government digital services. No public MW capacity found.
